tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot exhibits sig:high_freq_sign_oscillation, so a stationary smooth law cannot be reliably inferred for the target horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: Weibull, Avrami, or Richards stationary saturation models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed high-frequency sign oscillations are inconsistent with these smooth saturation mechanisms.
The paid pilot already reports the signature requiring scoped abstention.
The auxiliary probe is irrelevant to identifying the oscillatory mechanism.
